description: The various ways to specify when to call forward

unconditional.description: Pre-bridge, call forwarding settings are always used when enabled

busy.description: Post-dial attempt, call forwarding settings used if the SIP attempt returns busy (sip:486)

no_answer.description: Post-dial attempt, call forwarding settings used if the SIP attempt returns unanswered (sip:480)

selective.description: Conditionally check match lists to determine if call forwarding should be used

rules.description: Match list rules to check for call forwarding

allOf.description: Pre-bridge, check match lists for whether to forward the caller
